toc.t: She Did Not Love in Jest

toc.s: “Rosa never yielded on matters of ideas”
A truth not warmed by the heart is a truth betrayed
“Because they love no one, they think they love God”
Whoever has a “why” to live can bear almost any “how”
Taking the side of the poor is never a mistake
Truth reassures no one: it demands commitment
Cross the sea and come to us
An illustrated edition of the Gospel
